README.TXT
--------------------------

For use on real ZX81:
--
zx81-16k_lambda8300.rom - Modified Lambda v1 rom to be used on real ZX81 hardware, with known limitations. This is a 16KB rom - how to get this running on a real ZX81 can be found on the internet.

For use on OpenSpand - OpenSpand firmware 0.51.4 or higher is required for this to work.
--
zx81-16k_lambda8300.rom - RENAME to CUSTOM.COM and copy to root of SD Card
zx81-16k_lambda8300-overlay-pasmo.ovl - RENAME to CUSTOM.OVL and copy to root of SD Card

PROG - test programs for Lambda and OpenSpand.
--
BEEPTEST.P - Simple program to test Lambda beeper
FOLLIN1B.P - Advanced 1-bit multichannel, original ZX81 version by Kelly Murta@sinclairzxworld
LCMDR.P - Special minmal version of ZXPand Commander for Lambda
